g.text: “AI That Codes the Way I Want”
A method that compounds — guardrails + review surfaces + gates
Finding → Fix → Encode (smallest surface) → Promote down the spectrum
NOT magic — what’s automatic vs. deliberate
🤖 CI gates block merges on drift
Held by humans + AI on review
Rules move down as they prove value.
Disciplines — what the loop actually enforces
Plus: /feature-spec value gate + hole-test before a new feature ships.
Approval at the gate isn’t presence.
Set a budget + stop-time. Default = stop.
No mechanical gate catches these — only you can.
No sync-over-async · IDOR predicate in SQL · Outbox in non-handler code · CLAUDE.md ≤ 500 lines
Harnesses run the method. The method prevents drift.
Goal: ship faster AND get better every feature.
